title: PlaneMem signed Plane observation delivery
description: Complete existing HTTP observation input and durable delivery receipts. Root is the accepted input profile, not native Plane webhook JSON or CloudEvents. A structurally valid event can still queue or be rejected by stored history.
$comment: Source-only. Register the events package canonical-event/work-item-deleted/work-item-restored resources by their canonical IDs locally. Reuse individual canonical properties, not its closed root: validateEvent permits top-level extras and does not validate client_id, while this ingress adds source revision/URI and external-ID checks before persistence. Runtime additionally checks Date.parse, UTF-16/surrogates, signatures/time window, exact header/event binding, restore arithmetic and durable fingerprints/state. No validator or runtime evidence.

recordId.description: Exact untrimmed external/delivery ID, no leading/trailing whitespace or dot paths; interior whitespace allowed. Runtime counts UTF-16 units and also rejects lone surrogates. Not restricted to ULID.

source.description: Nonempty type/id/URI, no URI syntax/type allowlist or source existence check. Source extensions are allowed and echoed in the delivery response, but stripped before inbox event fingerprint/storage. Source order and duplicates remain meaningful.

payload.description: Ordinary create/update/status-confirmed payload is otherwise arbitrary JSON object, not a typed Plane-native field model. Absent external_id uses aggregate_id. String status is projected; other status values remain in fields only. Nonblank string title, then name, then external_id selects search title. Delete/restore add their existing strict payload requirements below.

occurred_at.description: Existing assertUtcTimestamp requires finite Date.parse and the Z$ pattern; no exact millisecond roundtrip, four-digit year restriction or format assertion. Original text and fractional precision are retained for normalization/fingerprint; database timestamptz has its own range/precision.

event.description: ProjectCreated/Updated pair with project; five supported WorkItem events pair with work_item. project_id is required only for delete/restore; otherwise absent project_id resolves scope to aggregate_id. Input identity/sensitivity are signed claims, not bearer-authorized values. Top-level extras/client_id are retained in the new inbox fingerprint without business parsing. No generalized finite-JSON/depth/node guard. Restore causation must equal distinct referenced deletion event, version exactly deletion+1; processing independently verifies committed deletion and matching unexpired index tombstones.

projectPair.description: Type-pair constraint only; combine with PlaneWebhookEvent for the full envelope.

workItemPair.description: Type-pair constraint only; WorkItemStatusProposed is not an accepted observation.

x-plane-timestamp.description: Original nonempty text converted by Number to a safe integer Unix second within inclusive +/-300 of floor(Date.now()/1000). Leading zeros, whitespace or exponent notation are not independently forbidden. The original text, not normalized decimal, participates in HMAC.

x-plane-signature.description: Exact lowercase v1= followed by HMAC-SHA256 hex of UTF-8(timestamp + '.' + decodedBodyText), using the configured shared secret. No signature-list/rotation syntax. Event/delivery/trace headers are not concatenated into HMAC; body event ID is compared separately.

headers.description: Documentary lowercase header map; actual HTTP names are case-insensitive. Initial verification requires nonempty four signature headers. Delivery-ID lexical checks occur later before persistence. No rejection of unrelated headers or bearer identity handling.

error.description: Standalone HTTP errors and optional nested processing errors use this shape. Early plain errorEnvelope may retain empty trace-header text; ContractError requires nonempty trace. No WCP data wrapper, schema_version, durability or event IDs in a standalone error. Error trace is stage-dependent.

receiptFields.description: Outer IDs echo this validated body and delivery header. Outer trace and sources echo the original input event, including source extensions; they are not the verification-header trace or normalized stored sources. Nested error trace comes from saved event. No outer scope/data/ETag/server_cursor/queue revision/fingerprint/signature/raw hash.

accepted.description: 200: this processing transaction appended the event, snapshot, search index, applied receipt and processing audit. Does not certify upstream native compatibility or later freshness.

duplicate.description: 200: already applied inbox or matching fields of a legacy committed event, with no new effect. No snapshot/index rebuild or current validity proof. Normal applied state has no error; result builder can include a truthy saved last_error_code, which the stored-event parser does not independently forbid.

queued.description: 202: durable receive committed but no application confirmed. Optional error comes from known pending reason, e.g. AGGREGATE_VERSION_GAP or PLANE_PROCESSING_RETRY. Missing error does not mean a worker has run; lock contention/not-yet-due/processing failure can return prior pending row.

rejected.description: 409 durable receipt: terminal stored processing refusal. Normal reject path sets last_error_code and includes error; builder only emits it when saved code is truthy, so no unconditional required error is invented. Same delivery does not reactivate rejected rows.
